annotations.title: Generate or edit an image with Kavel

description: Create an image from a prompt, or edit the user's photo, on their Kavel account. Pass `tool` (a slug from find_kavel_tool) to apply that effect's tuned recipe, with `prompt` holding the user's own details. Photo tools need a photo: the user's attachment in `photos`, or a public link in `image_urls`. Spends credits from the linked Kavel account. Usually returns the image within a minute; otherwise returns a task_id for check_kavel_generation.

image_urls.description: Photos to edit given as public http(s) links, when not attached.

photos.description: Photos the user attached in the chat. Required by photo tools.

prompt.description: The user's description, or their extra details when a tool is given.

tool.description: Optional image tool slug from find_kavel_tool.

name: generate_kavel_image
title: Generate or edit an image with Kavel
